items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: We made Mazitna spit blood. That Mazitna was playing.

ctx.x: I forgot the Owenwood band, most of all them colored fellas was dead in the hornwoods. Oh yeah. Most of all them colored fellas was dead in the hornwoods. They had a few colored fellas in the hornwoods. Because plenty of times, plenty of times, plenty of times, plenty of times Manny Perez used to play with the hornwoods. Big Iolo used to play with the hornwoods. Freddie Kepler used to play with the hornwoods. And, uh, the spell of what died there, the Piku, he played with the hornwoods. And, uh, the hornwoods.…

The other time, they told me about y'all. She told me that, I come last week, she says, you got somebody, one of the musicians wants to see you. I said, want to see me? I said, oh, I said, alright, I know what that's for. I said, take the record of the old time. She said, yeah. She said, do you? I said, yeah. They said, yeah. I said, yeah, that's true. I said, alright. I said, I'll be here. That's how I come. That's how I come. I said, when you first come drive. I said, Horace, somebody wants you. I said, I know…
